spl.name: Q-GARAK-EVALUATION.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=agentsec:external:evaluation earliest=0
| eval evidence_id=mvindex(mvdedup('external.evidence_id'),0)
| eval evidence_class=mvindex(mvdedup('external.evidence_class'),0)
| eval producer=mvindex(mvdedup('external.producer_class'),0)
| eval provider=mvindex(mvdedup('external.provider'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('external.tool'),0)
| eval tool_version=mvindex(mvdedup('external.tool_version'),0)
| eval target_type=mvindex(mvdedup('external.subject.type'),0)
| eval model=mvindex(mvdedup('external.subject.id'),0)
| eval native_result=mvindex(mvdedup('evaluation.native_result'),0)
| eval probe=mvindex(mvdedup('evaluation.probe'),0)
| eval detector=mvindex(mvdedup('evaluation.detector'),0)
| eval passed=mvindex(mvdedup('evaluation.passed'),0)
| eval fails=mvindex(mvdedup('evaluation.fails'),0)
| eval total_evaluated=mvindex(mvdedup('evaluation.total_evaluated'),0)
| eval raw_ref=mvindex(mvdedup('external.raw_evidence_ref'),0)
| eval raw_sha256=mvindex(mvdedup('external.raw_evidence_sha256'),0)
| eval correlation_method=mvindex(mvdedup('correlation.method'),0)
| eval correlation_value=mvindex(mvdedup('correlation.value'),0)
| table _time, evidence_id, producer, provider, evidence_class, tool, tool_version,
        target_type, model, native_result, probe, detector, passed, fails,
        total_evaluated, raw_ref, raw_sha256, correlation_method, correlation_value

spl.name: Q-EXTERNAL-EVIDENCE-PLANES.spl
spl.text:
index=agentsec_telemetry earliest=0
    (sourcetype=agentsec:scanner:finding OR
     sourcetype=agentsec:external:evaluation OR
     sourcetype=otel:agentic:json)
| eval evidence_plane=case(
    sourcetype=="agentsec:scanner:finding","STATIC FINDING",
    sourcetype=="agentsec:external:evaluation","ADVERSARIAL EVALUATION",
    sourcetype=="otel:agentic:json","RUNTIME",
    true(),"OTHER")
| eval external_class=mvindex(mvdedup('external.evidence_class'),0)
| eval correlation_method=mvindex(mvdedup('correlation.method'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| stats count, dc(_raw) as distinct_raw_events,
        values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes,
        values(event_name) as event_names,
        values(external_class) as external_classes,
        values(correlation_method) as correlation_methods
        by evidence_plane
| sort evidence_plane
